facts.fact: The Budget Support Group mission of 20-28 November 2025 notes progress in implementing Cabo Verde's national statistics development strategy (ENDE), so it is in force; the document gives no period.
facts.system: Estratégia Nacional de Desenvolvimento da Estatística (ENDE)

facts.fact: The Budget Support Group (Government, AfDB, Luxembourg, Portugal, Spain, EU, World Bank) took note of progress in implementing the ENDE during its 20-28 November 2025 mission and urged a dedicated statistics fund.
